title: Assign services and staff-specific prices or durations
summary: Choose what a person can perform and whether that assignment is available online.

sections.title: Update the person’s services
sections.body:
1. Open **Team & availability**, choose the person and select **Services**.
2. Use **Find a service** to locate the service. Select its qualification checkbox; **Select shown** applies to the displayed category group.
3. For a selected service, review **Online booking**.
4. Enter optional **Duration (min)** and **Price** overrides. Leave an override blank to inherit the service’s value; zero is a real price. Use the currency displayed beside the price.
5. If removing a capability used by future appointments, enter **Reason for removing a capability**.
6. Select **Save capabilities**.

sections.title: Check the full booking combination
sections.body: The person needs an active working profile, a shared service location and overlapping hours. Public booking also requires the service and person to be visible online. Check the Calendar service/staff choices after saving.

sections.title: Effect on existing appointments
sections.body: Changes apply to new selections. Existing appointment and completed-sale details retain their recorded performer, price and duration. Removing a capability does not automatically reassign existing visits.

sections.title: If the assignment cannot be changed
sections.body: Active booking holds can protect their selected capability. Resolve or wait for those holds, then refresh and review. A service with a future-dated configuration may require an authorized review rather than an immediate overwrite.
